summary: Show an Async Job for a Company
description: Return detailed information about a specified Async Job.

uuid.description: Unique identifier for the async job. Use as the {uuid} path parameter to poll this endpoint for the job's current status and result.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns this async job.

created_by_id.description: ID of the user who initiated the async job.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the async job. Poll this endpoint until the status is `completed` or `failed`; `result` is populated once the job succeeds.

result.description: Payload produced by the async job. Populated only after the job reaches `completed`; null while the job is pending, in progress, or failed. Shape depends on the job type.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the async job was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the async job, in ISO 8601 format. Advances as the job transitions between statuses.
